To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
consumers who are more knowledgeable of the green industry and its initiatives and green brands are more likely to purchase green apparel.

consumers who are more knowledgeable of green industry initiatives, green brands and the general environment, are more motivated to purchase green apparel and have a more positive attitude towards green apparel products.

consumer knowledge of environmental initiatives and green brands is positively correlated with purchase intention for green apparel, beliefs about corporate responsibility are positively correlated with purchase intent and actual purchase of green apparel, and subjective norms are positively correlated with both purchase intent and actual purchases for green apparel.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the purchase behavior of consumers for green apparel.
the purchase of environmentally-friendly products and the factors which influence the consumer"s purchase decision.
how the consumer perceives green apparel and the influence this perception has on their purchasing behavior.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
consumers are aware of green products and green initiatives and are motivated to buy green apparel products.
consumer attitudes towards purchasing green apparel is a function of knowledge, beliefs, subjective norms, and motivation.

the results of this study show that consumer knowledge of the green apparel industry, consumer beliefs about corporate social responsibility, consumer subjective norms, consumer motivations to purchase and consumer attitudes all influence the intention and behavior to purchase green apparel.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

this study provides a foundation for future research on the purchase behavior of green apparel products and the impact of green initiatives and green brands on consumer knowledge, beliefs and attitudes.
